scope_description: Projects with at least 10 API tests and at least 1 identified application endpoint.

method.project_value: Each measure is taken once per project: the share for a proportion measure, the mean for a distribution measure. A project without any unit of a measure is left out of that measure.
method.effect_sign: positive when selected projects tend to be higher
method.api_test_count_correlation: Two-sided Spearman rank correlation between API test count and the per-project value, over the selected and remaining projects together; undefined below three projects or for a constant value.
method.correction: holm, separately over the selection tests and over the correlations
method.untested: A measure with no defined value among the selected or among the remaining projects has no test or effect size and is left out of the correction.
method.limitations: The selected projects are few, so the test has little power; read a non-significant difference with its effect size. A project counts once per measure however few units it has, so a share over a handful of units weighs as much as one over hundreds; each project's units are listed with its value.
